intervention_description: Asset transfer program providing productive assets (mainly livestock) to ultra-poor households, with consumption support and skills training

graduation_components_rationale.consumption_support: Weekly consumption support of 90 rupees/week for 30-40 weeks mentioned
graduation_components_rationale.assets: Households chose productive assets like livestock or microenterprise inventory
graduation_components_rationale.skills_training: Implied by program design of asset transfer and support
graduation_components_rationale.social_empowerment: No explicit social empowerment activities described

outcomes.outcome_description: Principal component index of livestock, productive assets, and durable household items (standard deviation units)
Monthly per capita consumption in 2018 US dollar PPP (standard deviation units)
Composite index of household food security (standard deviation units)
Index of monthly loans and savings (standard deviation units)
outcomes.literal_text: 0.12 SD at year ten, statistically indistinguishable from zero

outcomes.outcome_description: Composite index of life satisfaction, sadness, and worry (standard deviation units)
outcomes.literal_text: 0.25 SD by year seven, remaining at this level until year ten (p < 0.01)

outcomes.outcome_description: Minutes spent on productive activities (standard deviation units)
outcomes.literal_text: 0.15 SD (30 more minutes) at year seven and year ten (p < 0.01)

Monthly earnings from nonfarm microenterprises in 2018 US dollars
